units.raw: The Parties wish to explore potential collaborative and commercial opportunities in financial technology and software integration (the "Permitted Purpose"). In doing so, either Party may disclose non-public, commercially sensitive or proprietary information to the other. This Agreement establishes the ground rules to protect that information.
